What is the area of the right triangle $ABC$ shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
Since $m∠A=m∠C={45}^{∘}$ and $AB=BC,$ we have an isosceles right triangle. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945897/assets/218d08d1f46e608c5fb7d1c2f5ddd136e601e15514dc829c686b35ff42b15a8f.png)

Therefore, the area of the triangle is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {9}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 81 \\  & =40.5\,.\end{aligned}
$$
